user.title: Set up SlimmeLezer Démász
user.description: Configure the internal Raw DSMR Telegram web endpoint. The integration polls once every 10 seconds and automatically adds newly observed OBIS registers.

error.cannot_connect: The endpoint is unavailable or did not return a valid Démász DSMR telegram.
error.invalid_url: Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS URL without credentials, query parameters, or a fragment.

init.title: Power sources and unknown OBIS reporting
init.description: Optionally select separate import and export power sensors. The integration creates a signed net power sensor as import minus export. Leave both empty to disable it. The default manual OBIS mode creates a Home Assistant repair and a prefilled GitHub issue form. Token status: {token_status}.

data.github_auto_report: Automatically create a privacy-safe GitHub issue
data.github_token: Fine-grained GitHub token (leave empty to retain the saved token)

data_description.github_auto_report: When disabled, only a local Repair and a prefilled issue form are created.
data_description.github_token: The token is stored in Home Assistant's private configuration and is excluded from diagnostics.
data_description.power_import_entity: A positive instantaneous power sensor representing consumption/import.
data_description.power_export_entity: A positive instantaneous power sensor representing production/export; it is subtracted from import.

error.token_required: A token is required for automatic GitHub reporting.
error.power_pair_required: Select both import and export power entities, or leave both empty.
error.power_entities_must_differ: Import and export must use different entities.
error.invalid_power_entity: Select an available sensor with the power device class.

new_obis.title: New OBIS register detected: {obis}
new_obis.description: SlimmeLezer found the undocumented `{obis}` register with {group_count} value group(s). The Learn more link opens a privacy-safe prefilled GitHub report. Verify the manufacturer and meter model before submission.
